payload.name: pc-check-timeout-ms
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that inspects a raw candidate timeout value and returns whether it is a valid integer in 0..7500 inclusive. It reads the raw candidate from inputs.get('timeout_ms') so that missing, null and non-integer values are returned as an invalid result rather than raising. A boolean is not an integer and is rejected. The original raw value is echoed back only when valid, otherwise null. No host calls, imports or I/O. This is an unapproved draft using the target typed inputs interface; it does not submit or activate.

composition_summary: Drafted one class-22 pure-logic component pc-check-timeout-ms with only name/description/content. The body reads the raw candidate via inputs.get('timeout_ms') so missing/null/non-integer values return {valid:false, timeout_ms:null} without raising or coercing; booleans are rejected because isinstance(True, int) is True. Valid means exact integer in 0..7500 inclusive and echoes the original integer; every outcome assigns result. No imports, host calls or I/O. This is an unapproved draft using the target typed inputs interface; it is not a submission or activation. The host sink supports class 22 name/description/content. Target provider metadata (catalogue_revision null, protocol_capabilities null) is not used to infer capabilities; typed-input transport remains a target interface requiring runner support before activation.
